eligibility_note: Conservative default: no newly imported food is auto-approved for meal planning. Eligibility requires separately validated preparation and safety policy; the existing pilot retains its own reviewed state in the app.
carbohydrate_definition: Available carbohydrate without sugar alcohols (g), not USDA carbohydrate by difference.
conversion: energy_kcal = energy_kj / 4.184; energy_kj is the original source field
warnings: Food state and allergens cannot be conclusively inferred from food names; left unverified.
AUSNUT measures include density and other technical measures; not all are user-friendly household portions.
AUSNUT survey foods can share public food keys with AFCD; do not deduplicate across datasets by public key.
Importer must use exact case-sensitive food_id prefixes AFCD_R3: and AUSNUT_2023:.
